pros: Inbox feels like email, so new agents need almost no training
Docs knowledge base and Beacon widget deflect questions before they become conversations
Contact based pricing lets the whole company have seats without extra cost
AI drafts and summaries pull from Docs and past conversations
cons: No formal SLA or priority model for contractual response targets
No native voice channel and no WhatsApp
Reporting is shallow for larger support operations
key_features: Customer and order data in view
verdict_line: Pick Help Scout if you want support to feel like well organised email and many part time teammates need seats without per seat fees.

pros: Internal comments and mentions inside the thread beat forwarding between departments
Rules engine routes by domain, owner, keyword, time or SLA breach
Salesforce and HubSpot records sit beside every conversation
Native macOS and Windows apps are fast for all day use
Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and chat in one view
cons: Per seat pricing gets expensive for large high volume agent teams
SLAs, SSO and advanced analytics only arrive on upper tiers
No native voice; phone needs Aircall or Dialpad
Ticket forms and multi brand help centres are basic
verdict_line: Pick Front if support, sales and operations share the same customer threads and most conversations happen over email and messaging.

pros: Refund, cancel or edit Shopify orders without leaving the ticket
AI Agent reads order data and takes actions, not only answers
Intent and sentiment detection drive routing and automatic replies
Native apps for Klaviyo, Recharge, Yotpo, Loop and Aftership
Ticket based pricing suits small teams with high volume
cons: Only makes sense for stores on Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento or WooCommerce
Ticket tiers and overages make seasonal peaks expensive
AI Agent resolutions are billed separately from the plan
Voice is an add-on and reporting is less flexible than Zendesk
key_features: Customer and order data in view
verdict_line: Pick Gorgias if you run a direct to consumer store on Shopify or BigCommerce and want agents and AI to act on orders inside the ticket.

pros: Customer journey timeline shows page views and events beside the ticket
SLAs, business hours, escalations and macros cover traditional ticketing needs
Classic edition can still be self-hosted for regulated environments
AI drafting trains on your resolved tickets and help centre
cons: Pricing is quoted on request rather than published
Small integration catalogue and slow development pace
No native voice or WhatsApp and a dated chat widget
Reporting and mobile apps lag the category leaders
verdict_line: Pick Kayako if you need self-hosted ticketing with SLAs or want AI drafting trained on years of existing Kayako ticket history.

pros: Tickets share the CRM record with sales and marketing activity
Workflow engine automates routing, escalation and follow-ups across objects
Custom report builder spans tickets, contacts and deals
Free tier includes ticketing, shared inbox and live chat
Breeze customer agent answers from knowledge base and website content
cons: SLAs, knowledge base, portal and AI agent need the Professional tier
Seats plus AI credits plus onboarding make total cost hard to predict
Help desk polish and app marketplace trail Zendesk
Weak value if you are not already on HubSpot
verdict_line: Pick HubSpot Service Hub if sales and marketing already run on HubSpot and you want support tickets on the same customer record.
